title: Small Fieldstone Cluster — Ukrainian steppe / forest-steppe terrain feature

sources.wentworth1922: Wentworth, C.K. (1922) — 'A scale of grade and class terms for clastic sediments', Journal of Geology vol. 30 no. 5, pp. 377–392. The global standard for sediment grain-size classification: pebble 4–64 mm, cobble 64–256 mm, boulder >256 mm.
sources.usgs_sediment: United States Geological Survey — 'Glossary of Geology', 5th ed. 2005 (American Geological Institute): cobble 64–256 mm (2.5–10 in), boulder >256 mm (>10 in), following Wentworth 1922.
sources.ukraine_geology: Lazarenko E.K. et al. — Mineralogy of Ukraine (1975, Naukova Dumka, Kyiv); Precambrian Ukrainian Shield (granites, gneisses, quartzites) crops out across the Dnipropetrovsk / Zaporizhzhia steppe belt and supplies sub-rounded fieldstones to the soil surface after glaciofluvial reworking, ploughing, or erosion.

size_class.note: Cluster of 6 fieldstones spanning upper cobble to lower small-boulder range (100–240 mm longest axis). Stones are sub-rounded to sub-angular — Precambrian granite/gneiss cobbles typical of Ukrainian steppe verges and cultivated fields.

stone_a.desc: Largest stone — oblate upper cobble / sub-boulder, longest axis 220 mm. Longest dimension falls below the 256 mm Wentworth cobble/boulder boundary.
stone_a.note: Dimensions are design values within the sourced Wentworth cobble range; exact field measurements are in needs[].

stone_b.desc: Large stone — oblate upper cobble, 190 mm longest axis.

stone_c.desc: Medium stone — mid cobble, 160 mm longest axis.

stone_d.desc: Medium stone — mid cobble, 140 mm longest axis.

stone_e.desc: Small stone — lower-mid cobble, 110 mm longest axis.

stone_f.desc: Smallest stone — lower cobble, 90 mm longest axis.

feature_inventory.stones: 6 sub-rounded fieldstones, paired large / medium / small; alternating plain granite and moss-colonised granite faces for visual variation
feature_inventory.surface_texture: Precambrian granite/gneiss — pale grey speckled (plagioclase + quartz + biotite); moss/lichen on shaded or partially buried faces
feature_inventory.shape: Oblate (flat-bottomed) cobbles — height roughly 0.7× plan width; partially embedded in the soil in the field, modelled floor-flush for game placement

material_notes.granite: palette material 'granite' — pale grey mid-tones (hi: #a8a8a4 / mid: #787874 / lo: #585854); plagioclase-quartzite character
material_notes.graniteMoss: palette material 'graniteMoss' — moss/lichen colonised surface, green-grey tones (hi: #788c58 / mid: #506040 / lo: #3c4a2e); upper and shaded faces of partially buried stones

game_model_purpose: Landscape scatter prop — steppe and forest-steppe terrain decoration; breaks up flat ground; can mark the edges of ruined structures or road verges
needs: Exact fieldstone dimensions from a Ukrainian geological field survey or a museum/catalog measurement (individual stone w/h/d values within the Wentworth cobble range are design values, not independently measured)
